supersedeStatement: v5-W1 does NOT supersede v4. W1 is a declaration file that points to v4 as the RPC body unchanged (option a). v5-W2 and v5-W3 are ADDITIONS alongside v4, covering orthogonal operations (session-create and join-accept). No v5 file conflicts with or supersedes any other candidate or applied migration.

residualOpen.summary: Case B NULL auth.uid() fail-closed path in v4: UNVERIFIED at runtime. Code is correct but no sandbox execution evidence yet.
Case G bounded intermediate-write fault (v4): STATE_BLOCKER in v4 documentation. Outside scope of v5 batch.
mig-133 trigger counts ALL rows, not just active (left_at IS NULL). If 4-active-row semantics needed, separate schema change required.
W2 session reconstruction: host_account_id is empty string in returned GroupCallSessionRow (RPC only echoes session ID). Callers needing full row should call getGroupCallSession().
W3 P0001 (4-cap trigger) rethrown as generic Error rather than a named class. Acceptable given THEORETICAL severity (no live caller confirmed). Can be tightened at activation time.
